response.diagnosis: The fixed sticky-promo bar overlays and blocks the fixed Add to Cart button
response.evidenceSummary: Screenshot shows only the black Free shipping promo bar at the bottom with no visible Add to Cart button. Probes at mobile, small, and desktop show #add-to-cart inViewport but hitIsSelf=false with hitElement #sticky-promo; CSS gives .sticky-promo fixed bottom:0 height:84px z-index:20 while .add-to-cart is fixed bottom:16px height:52px z-index:10, so the promo covers the button.
response.rationale: Raise the button 84px promo height plus 16px spacing above the promo so both elements remain visible and the button receives real pointer hits without removing or hiding either element.
